title: People who manage others
statementMd:
List employees who have at least one direct report.

Expected columns: `first_name`, `last_name`.

Tables: `employees`, `departments`.

Row order does not matter.
hints: `id IN (SELECT manager_id FROM employees WHERE manager_id IS NOT NULL)`.
solutionMd:
```sql
SELECT first_name, last_name FROM employees WHERE id IN (SELECT manager_id FROM employees WHERE manager_id IS NOT NULL);
```
